issue.title: Point preview and nightly builds at QA (qa.app / qa.api), not Dev
issue.body:
## Problem

Preview (`preview-build` label) and Nightly APKs currently target the **Dev** environment. We want those internal builds to use **QA** instead:

- Web / login (what testers open in a browser): [https://qa.app.fluent.bible/](https://qa.app.fluent.bible/) — **not** [https://dev.app.fluent.bible/](https://dev.app.fluent.bible/)
- Mobile API baked into the APK (`EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL`): `https://qa.api.fluent.bible` — **not** `https://dev.api.fluent.bible`

The mobile client never talks to `*.app.fluent.bible` (that is the Fluent **web** app). The APK must bake the matching **API** host so sign-in and sync hit the same QA backend as [qa.app.fluent.bible](https://qa.app.fluent.bible/).

## Current vs expected

| Surface | Current | Expected |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eas.json` `preview` / `nightly` env | `https://dev.api.fluent.bible` | `https://qa.api.fluent.bible` |
| `.github/workflows/preview-build.yml` | `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://dev.api.fluent.bible` | QA API |
| `.github/workflows/nightly-preview.yml` | `EXPECTED_DEV_API_URL: https://dev.api.fluent.bible` | QA API (rename the env if needed) |
| `.github/scripts/validate-nightly-api-url.sh` | Requires exact `dev.api.fluent.bible`; treats other `*.api.fluent.bible` as production | Allow / require `qa.api.fluent.bible`; still reject production |
| Docs / Slack / QA guides that say testers use Dev web | `https://dev.app.fluent.bible` | `https://qa.app.fluent.bible` |

## Scope

**In scope**
- EAS `preview` and `nightly` profiles (and the workflows/scripts that guard or inject the URL)
- Docs that describe which environment those APKs talk to (`.eas/README.md`, `.github/README.md`, QA preview / process guides, `.env.example` comments as needed)
- Nightly URL validation so `qa.api` is the expected host, not a false production fail

**Out of scope**
- Local / emulator Path A (`development` profile, engineer `.env`) unless docs only mention it in passing
- Production EAS / Play Store builds
- `e2e-test` / Maestro hosted-dev accounts (leave on Dev unless we separately confirm QA fixtures)
- iOS

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Preview and nightly APKs bake `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://qa.api.fluent.bible`
- [ ] Nightly (and preview, if it has a guard) URL validation expects QA and still fails on production-like hosts
- [ ] Docs and QA-facing copy tell testers to use [https://qa.app.fluent.bible/](https://qa.app.fluent.bible/) (not Dev web) as the matching web environment
- [ ] Local development default remains unchanged (localhost / hosted Dev for engineers)
- [ ] Confirm QA API is reachable and QA test accounts work before relying on the next nightly

## File pointers

- `eas.json` — `build.preview.env` / `build.nightly.env`
- `.github/workflows/preview-build.yml`
- `.github/workflows/nightly-preview.yml`
- `.github/scripts/validate-nightly-api-url.sh`
- `.env.example`, `.eas/README.md`, `.github/README.md`, `docs/guides/qa-preview-testing.md`, `docs/guides/local-development-workflow.md`

## Notes

Needs QA? **Yes** after merge — next nightly must sign in against QA data, not Dev.
